name: icon_hand
ref_note: The attached image is a RENDERING reference only (outline weight, white sticker border, matte flat colours, the orange-and-white tabby fur). Draw only a paw and forearm, not a whole cat.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: mobile game tutorial pointer icon (shown about 100 px, rotated by the game as needed)
Subject: a cute cat's front PAW and short forearm reaching straight UP from the bottom of the image to boop something, like a cat tapping a button: a chubby rounded paw at the top shaped like a mitten (all toes together, NO separate fingers, NO extended finger, just three tiny curved toe lines on the rounded tip), cream-white paw with a soft orange tabby forearm below it with two darker orange stripes, ending in a rounded cut at the bottom. The paw tip is the pointer.
Style: 2D cartoon sticker icon with a thick dark-brown outline and a clean thin white sticker border. MATTE finish: flat colours with at most one soft shadow tone, NO glossy highlights, NO gradients, NO glow, NO halo, NO soft light around the sticker.
Composition: perfectly vertical, the rounded paw tip at the top centre, centred horizontally, generous padding, no ground shadow, no motion lines.
Background: genuinely transparent background (alpha) everywhere outside the white sticker border, with hard edges.
Constraints: one paw only, no text, no watermark, nothing cropped.
